findings.title: Admission is downstream of executable candidate inspection
findings.trigger: selectExecutionDriver evaluates an ACP candidate that declares identityProbes before the Packet's enforcement dimensions have been admitted.
findings.impact: The supposedly fail-closed path can execute unqualified adapter or runtime code with the probe environment before it rejects the Packet, leaving file and network effects outside the enforcement decision.
findings.evidence: The call at line 905 precedes the gate at line 943. selectExecutionDriver synchronously invokes identity probes for the selected profile before returning; the gate therefore cannot make the statement at lines 939-940 true.
findings.suggestion: Move a provider-neutral all-transports-unavailable precheck ahead of driver selection, or split pure selection from process-backed identity attestation and run attestation only after admission permits that candidate.

findings.title: Typed enforcement state is discarded by both CLI launchers
findings.trigger: HostEnforcementUnavailableError crosses the direct delegate.cjs or bin/install.js process boundary.
findings.impact: Automation loses error.code, admission dimensions and the evidence digest, collapsing a recoverable capability stop into an untyped generic process error.
findings.evidence: The error object defines code and admission, but delegate.cjs prints only message; bin/install.js awaits handle and its top-level catch likewise prints only Fatal plus message. No canonical JSON failure projection is emitted.
findings.suggestion: Centralize one redacted error projection for these two existing launchers and make the process output include the stable code, admission and recovery-safe message without exposing environment values.

findings.title: The installed diagnostic cites evidence that is not packaged
findings.trigger: A user invokes the installed npm package outside this development repository and receives the ZCode unavailable diagnostic.
findings.impact: The error cites .ultra/evidence/vnext-d1-host-enforcement-qualification/host-enforcement-receipt.json, but npm pack excludes the repository .ultra tree, so the stated recovery and audit reference does not exist in the installed product.
findings.evidence: package.json publishes the ultra-delegate Skill and selected docs but no repository .ultra/evidence path; npm pack --dry-run succeeds with 141 entries and contains no host-enforcement-receipt.json.
findings.suggestion: When an inspectable shipped receipt is needed, place the redacted immutable observation under the existing Skill reference tree and bind that packaged path, or explicitly distinguish a source-repository-only provenance URI from an installed recovery path.

findings.title: Admission compares retained identity with expected profile constants
findings.trigger: A later positive qualification record is evaluated after an adapter or runtime is rebuilt without changing its reported version markers.
findings.impact: identityMatch compares qualified_identity with profile.acp.candidateIdentity, which is another expected constant rather than the concrete observed candidate result, so a same-marker replacement can inherit a prior positive capability claim.
findings.evidence: The receipt retains adapter and runtime SHA-256 values, but the qualification record and identityMatch use only buildMarker/runtimeVersion fields. The current negative record remains unavailable, so this does not presently admit ZCode effects.
findings.suggestion: Do not promote a future supported record until admission consumes a concrete observed identity attestation appropriate to that Host; keep the current negative route simple rather than adding unused attestation machinery now.

positive_observations: The admission function is pure, provider-neutral and reuses the existing Host profile instead of introducing a second policy engine.
Unsupported, unobserved, missing, unknown and version-mismatched facts remain distinct in the in-process decision.
limitations: The same-version identity concern is non-blocking for the current negative ZCode record and becomes material before any future positive capability promotion.
